caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #91: IMPERVIOUS

impervious (adjective): not able to be affected or penetrated.

✅ In a sentence: The coat is impervious to rain; he seemed impervious to criticism.
✅ Similar: resistant, immune, impenetrable
✅ Remember it: Usually "impervious to."
